decisions.title: Use a local-first data model
decisions.context: CHB must remain usable without internet and on multiple devices.
decisions.decision: Dexie is the primary local store; Supabase synchronizes snapshots without replacing local-first behavior.
consequences: UI updates do not wait for the network
Conflicts require safe comparison and explicit resolution
Cloud synchronization is debounced for older hardware

decisions.title: Use WorkDay as the source of truth for daily work data
decisions.context: Dashboard, Work and future statistics must calculate from identical records.
decisions.decision: Paid messages, held messages, beers, rating and sessions are stored on WorkDay.
consequences: Weekly totals are derived from days
Dashboard edits the same records as the Work page
Legacy weekly heldMessages remains temporarily for compatibility

decisions.title: Use tables as the primary daily work interface
decisions.context: The user works faster in spreadsheet-like interfaces than in detached forms.
decisions.decision: Daily work values are edited inline with keyboard navigation; forms are reserved for complex configuration.
consequences: Enter saves values
Table density is configurable
Future data-heavy modules should reuse the table system

decisions.title: Centralize application preferences
decisions.context: Preferences will expand to colors, tab order, layouts and future modules.
decisions.decision: Components use appSettingsService and useAppSettings rather than reading Dexie directly.
consequences: Preferences are synchronized and backed up automatically
UI reacts to preference changes
Future settings share one architecture

decisions.title: Use machine-readable project data as documentation source
decisions.context: The roadmap and changelog are too large to maintain reliably by hand.
decisions.decision: docs/data JSON is authoritative; Markdown and AI context files are generated outputs.
consequences: Documentation can be validated
Multiple AI providers can consume the same project interface
Manual edits to generated files are overwritten

decisions.title: Keep the AI Project Interface vendor-neutral
decisions.context: The project may later use Cursor, OpenAI, Anthropic, Copilot, Gemini, MCP or local models.
decisions.decision: Use plain JSON, JSON Schema and generated Markdown without provider-specific requirements in the core.
consequences: Provider adapters can be added later
Project context remains portable
Core project data does not require an AI SDK

decisions.title: Generate provider adapters from one AI Project Interface
decisions.context: Different coding agents use different conventional context files.
decisions.decision: Keep canonical context in docs/data and generate AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules as disposable adapters.
consequences: Provider files never become independent sources of truth
A new provider can be added without changing project data
Generated adapters are checked for drift in CI and release preparation

decisions.title: Analytical modules do not duplicate domain data
decisions.context: The Alcohol module needs Work beer data and Portfolio expenses while preserving historical corrections.
decisions.decision: Domain modules own their data. Analytical modules read source data and store only their own settings, corrections and metadata. Before implementing a feature, determine the data owner, verify whether existing data can be reused, and classify the module as a data owner or an analytical consumer.
consequences: Every new feature identifies one owning module for each stored value.
Existing source data is reused instead of copied into parallel storage.
Analytical modules store only settings, corrections and metadata.
Backup, restore and cloud synchronization serialize the complete connected ecosystem.

decisions.title: Work time analytics are derived from session blocks
decisions.context: Standard, additional and weekend time plus weekday ratings are needed without creating parallel stored totals.
decisions.decision: Split absolute session intervals at time-of-day, midnight and weekend boundaries. Calculate all category totals, daily scores and weekly averages dynamically from Work sessions.
consequences: Cross-midnight sessions are assigned according to the real calendar minute.
No derived rating or duration totals are persisted.
Future monthly and yearly analysis can reuse the same engine.

decisions.title: Panel expansion state is local UI state
decisions.context: Collapsible panels need to remember the user's local layout without adding domain data or forcing the same open panels on every device.
decisions.decision: Store panel open and closed state in localStorage. Do not include it in Dexie, backup or Supabase during the pilot.
consequences: Panel state survives browser reloads on one device.
Panel layout can differ between desktop and mobile devices.
No database migration or cloud snapshot change is required.

decisions.title: Debt balances use manual real-world corrections
decisions.context: Creditors may add costs after a payment, but detailed interest modelling would create unnecessary complexity.
decisions.decision: Record payments manually and allow the user to replace the current balance with the value shown by the creditor. Save the difference as a balance-update event.
consequences: Payments and balance corrections remain auditable.
No automatic interest model is required.
Portfolio transactions are not linked to debts in this release.
